Next validate each entry in list order with parse_track and, at the first failure, return {"ok": false, "error": "track <n>: <reason>"} where <n> is the 1-based index and <reason> is parse_track's error. Only after every entry validates, apply duplicate handling: two tracks are duplicates when artist and title match ignoring letter case. Unless allow_duplicates is true, stop at the first repeat and return {"ok": false, "error": "duplicate track <n>"} naming the 1-based position of the LATER occurrence; if allow_duplicates is true, keep every validated track in input order. On success return ok true, count, total_seconds (sum of seconds of every kept track), total_clock from format_clock(total_seconds), and tracks: the kept tracks in input order, each as {"id", "title", "artist", "seconds", "explicit", "clock"} where id is assigned in processing order as T01, T02, and so on, zero-padded to at least two digits, and clock is format_clock(track seconds). An empty list is a valid success with count 0. Do not change parse_track, format_clock, or the remaining stubs.
